svg.title: North Western Railway streaming data pipeline
svg.desc: Engine telemetry flows from the engines into a Kafka topic on Confluent Cloud with three partitions. Two independent consumer groups read the same stream: a Snowflake Sink Connector writes events to Snowflake, and an ECS Fargate task taps the stream and pushes live readings to the web view over Server-Sent Events. Analytics queries round-trip from the web view through the ECS task to Snowflake.
